text: SBFM could not have been found pre-open by a gainer or gap scan: pre-market high was about +5% on about 21K shares and it was flat until 16:25 SAST (55 min after the open). The only advance signal was the Oct 5-6 setup: an S-1 dilution gap-down (-29%) to near the 52-week low on 15-40x normal volume, float about 4.2M, price under $1. A one-minute check in the first hour would have caught it at about 16:25-16:26 SAST, at about +20%, before the 300K-600K share-per-minute bars.
